title: Smartest way to scale without marketing
description: Smartest way to scale without marketing
transcript: There's a concept inside the SAS world called product lead growth you use tyros or use tyros right so I always use this example because they're like one of the most expensive software we have and and Hiro's for those who don't know it's an attribution tracking software and the more money you make the more they charge you it's like a tiered structure right at our level you're paying thousands of dollars a month and I remember recently like we hit another level in one of the companies and like I was on the call with my media director and he's like, yeah, we got upgraded and it just hit me I was like, they just added $12,000 in AR they didn't have to do any email blast not any text messages I didn't get any sales calls I just made 12,000 and it's so simple but like coming from the non sass world and that was when someone introduced me to the the concept known as product like growth and so most of what we do in the marketing high ticket coaching consulting world is like marketing like growth and that's like promotions and ads and emails and sets and outbound and all that which is nothing wrong are you and I both been successful doing that but product like growth in my opinion is like the level up from that where you build into the products themselves a hierarchy like you recreate your entire product suite to Where the products themselves naturally lead to the next one. And so people will upgrade on their own. And so when I heard that concept, that was when I was like, okay, well then, and I had done low ticket to high ticket before, but this is not that. This is like, I actually changed my whole business model around focusing on the subscription scaling school as the primary thing for the entire company. We are no longer a high ticket business. We are a recurring business. We have high ticket sales, but that's just a few recurring.
